newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO CATTLE REPORT, FEEDER EXPORT PRICE - USDA.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO CATTLE REPORT, FEEDER EXPORT PRICE - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Wednesday that around 500 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Tuesday.
Through Del Rio, Texas, around 200 head were sold and through Laredo, Texas, another 300 head were exported. USDA said not enough trade was recorded to establish quote or trend prices.
